note: Both sets are largely accurate and share 20 of 25 claims, correctly binding conductor material, sizes, ground conductors and conduit sizes to the right schedule symbols (e.g. 20 = CU 3#12, #12G., 3/4"C.; 150 = AL 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C.). Set A adds clean, supported facts (34 conductor count/size 6#10, 50 conductor configuration 3#6, 150 conductor 3#4/0) with no errors, while Set B adds equally valid facts (151 conductor 3#4/0, 33 and 31 ground #10G, 150 conduit 2-1/2") but attaches an invented condition 'C.' to the 34 conduit-size claim, where 'C.' is only the abbreviation for conduit. Coverage of unique facts is about even, so the deciding defect is B's spurious condition field; A is marginally cleaner.
